The query returned **7180 mainnet blocks** for 20 June 2026 from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`. Each row shows the `slot`, `block_root`, `slot_start_date_time`, and `first_seen_ms` (milliseconds after slot start when the block was first observed by any node). Here's a summary:

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Slot range | `14590570` – `14597998` |
| Date range (first block) | `2026-06-20 00:00:11` |
| Date range (last block) | `2026-06-20 23:59:59` |
| Total blocks | 7,180 |
| Fastest first-seen | **215 ms** (slot 14597916) |
| Slowest first-seen | **3,725 ms** (slot 14597760) |
| Typical (most entries) | ~1,200–3,500 ms |
